spec_match.rationale: Implements the spec's check order: label/context/length RangeError gates before the state check, with the Chromium 1..4096 ceiling from the chromestatus summary.

interactive.rationale: Three numeric fields plus five boundary presets fire real calls and append spec-says vs browser-did rows with match verdicts.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Blurb promises dialable sizes and real calls needing no server; delivered.

edge_cases.rationale: This is the edge page: all four gates plus the valid-maxima case, and an above-4096 nuance allowing a higher implementation ceiling.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/<id> plus the exact spec anchor in see-also.

conformance.rationale: Mirrors ekm-label/context/zero RangeError and 4096-floor assertions in the feature suite.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Verified on headless Chromium 141 (predates Chrome 158, feature absent even behind --enable-experimental-web-platform-features) via Playwright 1.56 at desktop 1280x800 and mobile 360x740 DPR3 touch, driving every control; screenshots under /tmp/claude-0/agentB/shots/. Presets appended rows reading 'method missing on this build' with match n/a and the no-pretending notice; real RangeError timing needs a 158 build.

telemetry_health.rationale: showcaseTelemetry.assert covers the primary contract and the explicit fallback branch; console output is intentional and prefixed.

design_system.rationale: Only CSS variables from public/styles.css; buttons overriding background also set color; AA pairs (text-charcoal/bg-stone, bg-ivory/text-black, accent-emerald-dark on paper).

accessibility.rationale: Native controls with labels, visible focus (verified first-Tab), caption+scope tables, aria-live polite result regions.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Preset buttons wrap into the grid on mobile; table scrolls in its wrapper.

openQuestions.title: Re-verify the supported path on a real Chrome 158 / Canary build
openQuestions.detail: This environment's Chromium 141 lacks the surface even behind --enable-experimental-web-platform-features, so only the honest-absent branch ran. On Chrome 158 (or Canary with the feature's runtime flag) verify: each gate's real rejection: RangeError for 256-byte label/context and length 0/4097, and InvalidStateError only for the all-valid call.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use native labelled controls with adequate touch targets and visible hints for constraints.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: All controls are native button/select/input/radio elements with <label for> associations, min-height 44px, and inline constraint hints.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use intrinsically-sized grid/flex layouts (auto-fit + minmax) so panels reflow without horizontal overflow at narrow widths.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Control panels use grid-template-columns repeat(auto-fit, minmax()), tables are wrapped in overflow-x containers, and long tokens use overflow-wrap: anywhere; verified no horizontal overflow at 360px.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Landmarks, native semantics, accessible names, visible focus, and polite live regions for asynchronous state changes.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Content sits in main/header/footer landmarks; async results land in aria-live=polite output/status elements; tables carry caption plus th scope=col; first-Tab focus visibility verified in the browser.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Announce error/failure outcomes programmatically, not only visually.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Real API errors (name + message) are written into aria-live output regions and colour is never the only signal (text states the outcome).

summary: A validation lab whose spec-says column is explicitly the contract and whose browser-did column is only ever real output.
